synopsis: Synopsys AVxcelerate Sensors, formerly Ansys, is a commercial sensor-simulation tool rather than a complete platform [f15917, f9058]. It provides physics-oriented camera, lidar, radar and thermal simulation for SIL/HIL testing, with documented co-simulation with CarMaker and CARLA [f8531, f8532, f15946]. Chapter 11 identifies 2026 R1 as the current/latest release found and reports quote-only pricing [f8533, f9063, f8537, f9062]. No off-road evidence was found, consistent with the glossary's broader finding that none of the named commercial sensor-simulation tools had public off-road validation [f8538, f9059, f15951]. Continental is a documented automotive collaborator, but that relationship does not establish off-road performance [f8536].
